In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
glycosylated hemoglobin is the most accurate test for the assessment of long term glycaemic status of diabetic subjects.
the HbA1C is the gold standard for the assessment of long-term glycaemic control and is the only reliable indicator of the risk of developing long-term complications in diabetic patients.
the study of glycosylated hemoglobin is a very useful tool for the management and monitoring of diabetic patients.
